subject: general
question: Read the following table carefully and answer the given question. The table shows the number of candidates who appeared for the interview for the post of officer in ABC Bank from five different states of India. State→ Year↓ Bihar Uttar Pradesh Madhya Pradesh Punjab
solution:
**Given:**

The number of candidates who appeared for the interview for the post of officer in ABC Bank from Bihar in 2012 is 410.

The total number of candidates from all states in 2012:

 
• Bihar: 410
 
• Uttar Pradesh: 300
 
• Madhya Pradesh: 250
 
• Punjab: 280
 
• Kerala: 440

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Number of candidates from Bihar / Total number of candidates from all states) × 100

**Calculation:**

Total candidates from all states in 2012 = 410 + 300 + 250 + 280 + 440 = 1680

Percentage = (410 / 1680) × 100

⇒ Percentage ≈ 24.4%

**∴ The number of candidates who came from Bihar in 2012 is approximately 24% of the total number of candidates who came from all the states in that year.**
